item.title: Ask HN: What would make you list your AI product on a new marketplace?
item.summary: Right now the AI tool that wins is the one with the biggest marketing budget and hype, not the one that works best. We want a marketplace where sellers have to show proof, so buyers can tell the difference before they pay. We are trying to bring proof and quality to the AI market. We are building it now. It is not open yet, and before we go further we want to know what would actually make someone list on it. If you sell an AI tool: what has gone wrong for you on existing marketplaces and directories? What would make you list on a new one, and what would make you walk away? While building it we made two free tools, no signup. The Achboard reads any AI product's website like a sceptical buyer would. Comparima shows a product next to its closest alternatives with what each costs. Both at achrima.com Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49185927 Points: 1 # Comments: 1
